name: R04 Budget vs Actual by Cost Center

statements:
SELECT
  FISCAL_CALENDAR.FISCAL_YEAR,
  COST_CENTERS.COST_CENTER_NAME,
  COST_CENTERS.REGION,
  SUM(CASE WHEN GL_ENTRIES.ACCOUNT_NUMBER BETWEEN 4000 AND 4999 THEN GL_ENTRIES.AMOUNT END),
  SUM(CASE WHEN GL_ENTRIES.ACCOUNT_NUMBER BETWEEN 5000 AND 5999 THEN GL_ENTRIES.AMOUNT END)
FROM
  CNR_FIN.COST_CENTERS  COST_CENTERS,
  CNR_FIN.FISCAL_CALENDAR  FISCAL_CALENDAR,
  CNR_FIN.GL_ENTRIES  GL_ENTRIES
WHERE
  ( GL_ENTRIES.COST_CENTER_ID=COST_CENTERS.COST_CENTER_ID  )
  AND  ( GL_ENTRIES.PERIOD_START=FISCAL_CALENDAR.PERIOD_START  )
  AND  ( FISCAL_CALENDAR.FISCAL_YEAR = 2025 )
GROUP BY
  FISCAL_CALENDAR.FISCAL_YEAR,
  COST_CENTERS.COST_CENTER_NAME,
  COST_CENTERS.REGION

SELECT
  FISCAL_CALENDAR.FISCAL_YEAR,
  COST_CENTERS.COST_CENTER_NAME,
  COST_CENTERS.REGION,
  SUM(CASE WHEN BUDGET.ACCOUNT_NUMBER BETWEEN 4000 AND 4999 THEN BUDGET.BUDGET_AMOUNT END),
  SUM(CASE WHEN BUDGET.ACCOUNT_NUMBER BETWEEN 5000 AND 5999 THEN BUDGET.BUDGET_AMOUNT END)
FROM
  CNR_FIN.BUDGET  BUDGET,
  CNR_FIN.COST_CENTERS  COST_CENTERS,
  CNR_FIN.FISCAL_CALENDAR  FISCAL_CALENDAR
WHERE
  ( BUDGET.COST_CENTER_ID=COST_CENTERS.COST_CENTER_ID  )
  AND  ( BUDGET.PERIOD_START=FISCAL_CALENDAR.PERIOD_START  )
  AND  ( FISCAL_CALENDAR.FISCAL_YEAR = 2025 )
GROUP BY
  FISCAL_CALENDAR.FISCAL_YEAR,
  COST_CENTERS.COST_CENTER_NAME,
  COST_CENTERS.REGION
